messages:
Marta: Heads up — anyone bring extra USB-C earbuds for my flight? Mine disappeared at TSA checkpoint :sob:
Nate: Ugh been there. I keep a cheap spare in the laptop sleeve just for this reason.
Priya: I actually have an extra pair of wired buds and a small case, can bring to the hotel. PM me which night.
Marta: You're a lifesaver, thanks! I'll be arriving late Thu. @Priya ping me and I'll meet you at the lobby. :pray:
Nate: FYI for everyone: if you put headphones in the outer pocket they tend to get grabbed when you toss a bag on the belt. Learned the hard way.
Sam: Quick poll — noise-canceling headphones for a 6h redeye: overkill or essential? :thinking_face:
Priya: Essential for me. I sleep like a baby on planes with ANC.
Marta: Essential for red-eye. Otherwise earbuds + sleep mask works fine.
Nate: Lean essential but depends on carry-on weight. I brought light foam earplugs one trip and they did the trick.
Sam: ok voting time: Marta: yes, Nate: lean yes, Priya: yes, Sam: yes
ops-bot: Reminder: Conference travel checklist posted in #help — bring chargers, ID, and patience :robot_face: 
Marta: Also tiny pro-tip: put a zipped sandwich bag with chargers/passport at the top of your bag (instant security-ready). Saved me last minute.
Priya: Another tip: if your hotel has early check-in, DM the front desk before arrival. Marriott in SoMa let me drop bags early last offsite.
Nate: Meme: "airport headphones 0 — TSA 1" (image)
Sam: 😂 Okay, last thing — does anyone have a spare USB-C charging cable I can borrow for the meetup day? I'll return with snacks.
Priya: I've got one. I'll leave it at the hotel front desk with your name.
Marta: Thanks all. If my earbuds show up in TSA lost & found I'll post. If not, Priya — I'll meet you at 7p in the lobby. :thumbsup:
Nate: Safe travels y'all. See you at the offsite.
Marta: @here also bring a sweater — conference rooms run cold.
